articles.summary: Favorable safety and tolerability profile maintained through up to 60 weeks of treatment with ontunisertib in Fibrostenosing Crohn’s disease (FSCD) patients Low annualized FSCD-related event rate of 3%, with one endoscopic balloon dilation (EBD) and no surgeries reported over the full treatment period Radiological assessment shows trend for fibrotic stricture stabilization over treatment course Sustained […]
articles.title: Agomab Reports Positive Topline Data from STENOVA Open-Label Extension Study of Ontunisertib in Fibrostenosing Crohn’s Disease
